correctness.rationale: Exact partition Q_r=rR+S of the finite-state generator: R_FF=-diag(number of interior particles), so the fast-state resolvent and reduced generator are analytic in 1/r. The reduced chain has unique recurrent state (1,0,...,0). The only order-one/r fast state is (0,1,0,...,0); its slow injection supplies S_2 at coefficient alpha (and for L=2 its extraction supplies the empty state at coefficient beta). First-order reduced S_j transitions are right hops of rate 1, effective reset return S_j -> S_2 of rate 1/2 for j>=3, and terminal extraction beta. Flux equations beta*c_L=alpha, c_{j-1}=3*c_j/2 and c_{L-1}=(beta+1/2)*c_L prove all coefficients and boundary exception. Correlation follows from exact binary identity. The independent standard-library rational generator test reports 1,734 exact assertions. It is a finite test, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Physically motivated boundary-blocking effect in a model previously explored via mean-field and large-system limits. The leading exact finite-volume stationary measure exhibits geometric upstream amplification, universal alpha/r throughput independent of beta and L for L>=3, a distinct L=2 boundary crossover, and negative covariance at the same order as sparse occupation. These are structural and observable facts that test where factorized approximations and exchange of limits fail, beyond a routine finite-chain enumeration.
